about_the_game:
The Treasure of Anubis

Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets in this 2D adventure inspired by the ancient pyramids of Egypt.

Immerse yourself in a world of mystery and adventure

Egypt hides a great secret: The Treasure of Anubis, a legendary relic that has remained concealed for centuries. In this 2D platform adventure, you take on the role of a young archaeologist who, after failing in his first expeditions, receives one last chance to prove his worth.

To reach the Great Gate, you must collect the 9 sacred keys, avoid deadly traps, solve puzzles, and explore temples filled with mysteries. But beware… you are not alone in this mission.

Demo available – The Treasure of Anubis: Beyond the Treasure

Exclusive features of the demo:

  • Unique levels not included in the final version.

  • Exclusive puzzles designed for the demo.

  • Statistics and ranking system.

  • Full soundtrack.

  • Available in all supported languages.

Demo Story:

After finding the Treasure of Anubis, our protagonist attempts to escape from the last pyramid to share his discovery with the world. But as he tries to leave, the structure begins to collapse. Now he must find his way out as quickly as possible… or be buried forever.

Technical Information

  • Genre: Adventure / 2D Platformer / Puzzles

  • Languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Croatian, Hindi, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean.

  • Players: 1 (offline)

  • Difficulty:

    • Gameplay: Easy

    • Exploration: Medium

    • Puzzles: Medium – Hard

  • Visual Style: 2D with minimalist graphics

Main Features

  • Main objective: Gather the 9 sacred keys to unlock the Treasure of Anubis.

  • Exploration & puzzles: Avoid traps, activate mechanisms, and solve enigmas to progress.

  • Internal achievement system: 30 achievements to put your skills to the test.

Collectibles

  • 3 special coins in each level for full exploration.

  • 16 hidden Egyptian busts inside the pyramids.

  • 25 secret treasures scattered across the levels.

Side Quests

  • Gather 3 scarab amulets for the photographer.

  • Find the secret boomerang.

  • Discover the Book of Anum, a mysterious object filled with secrets.

Alternate Endings

4 different endings depending on your progress and the items collected, without restarting the game.

Levels & Duration

36 main levels + sublevels, with an estimated playtime of 4 to 15 hours.

Gameplay

Platforming, exploration, stealth, and puzzles.

Music

Immerse yourself in the mystical atmosphere of ancient Egypt with an original soundtrack composed exclusively for the game.
With more than 41 unique musical pieces, it blends traditional Egyptian instruments with modern arrangements to create an immersive experience that will accompany you through every discovery, puzzle, and challenge.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with WDDM 1.0 driver
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard or gamepad recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Tarjeta gráfica compatible con DirectX 11 o posterior con controlador WDDM 1.0.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard or gamepad recommended
